director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket score se fractions ko number line par dekhenge. Cricket mein tumhe batting pasand hai ya bowling?
Koi baat nahi, batting ya bowling chunna zaroori nahi. Cricket pitch ko do barabar hisson mein baantein, toh aadhe raste par kya hoga?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak ek seedha rasta socho. Use 5 barabar gaps mein baanto; pehla gap kahan khatam hoga?
Haan Riya, dheere chalte hain. Line par 0 se 1 tak ki jagah socho. Use 5 barabar gaps mein baanto. Pehla gap kahan khatam hoga?
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, sankhya rekha par 0 se 1 tak ki doori ko 5 barabar hisson mein baantna hai. Kul kitne hisse honge?
Haan Riya, kul 5 barabar hisse. Sankhya rekha par 0 se 1 tak unke beech 5 barabar faasle honge. Pehla faasla kahan khatam hoga?
Riya, pehla faasla 0 ke turant baad pehli nishani par khatam hota hai. Ab 2/5 ke liye: neeche ka 5 batata hai ki 0 se 1 tak 5 barabar faasle chahiye. Itna theek?
Riya, socho: 0 se 1 tak paanch barabar hisse hain. 0 se doosre hisse ke baad wali nishani kahan hogi?
Riya, “haan” se jagah nahi pata chalti. Doosre hisse ke baad wali nishani 0 se doosri nishani hai, yani 2/5. Kaunsi nishani?
Riya, tumne 7 kaha. Main pooch rahi thi 0 se ginte hue doosri nishani kaunsi hai. Tumhara 7 kis cheez ke liye tha?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Riya, tum aaj ke liye rukna chahti ho, theek hai. Chaaho toh aage badhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye band karein—kya chunogi?
